title.zh: 查询批量注册设备申请的处理状态和结果
title.en: Query the processing status and result of a batch device registration request

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

批量注册设备时，可调用本接口根据申请批次ID（**ApplyId**），查看设备名称校验结果或注册结果。

使用自定义设备名称批量注册设备时，必须先调用本接口确保自定义设备名称全部校验通过，再调用[BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId](~~69514~~)接口根据对应申请批次ID完成设备注册。

> - 如果有校验失败的设备名称，请根据错误信息提示进行修正，然后重新调用[BatchCheckDeviceNames](~~69482~~)接口获取新的申请批次ID（**ApplyId**）后，再次调用**QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus**接口确认全部设备名称校验通过。
- 如果返回的**Status**为**CHECK**，请耐心等待。批量注册设备有一个过程，您可再次调用本接口查看**Status**确认全部设备名称校验通过。

使用自定义设备名称批量注册设备的完整流程，请参见[BatchCheckDeviceNames](~~69482~~)的**使用说明**。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为30。
 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  

When registering devices in batches, you can call this API with the application batch ID (**ApplyId**) to view the device name validation results or registration results.  

If you use custom device names for batch registration, you must first call this API to ensure that all custom device names pass validation before invoking the [BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId](~~69514~~) API with the corresponding **ApplyId** to complete device registration.  

> - If any device names fail validation, correct them according to the error message, then call the [BatchCheckDeviceNames](~~69482~~) API again to obtain a new **ApplyId**. Afterward, call the **QueryBatchRegisterDeviceStatus** API again to confirm that all device names have passed validation.  
- If the returned **Status** is **CHECK**, please wait patiently. Batch device registration involves a procedure. You can call this API again later to check the **Status** and confirm that all device names have passed validation.  

For the complete flow of batch device registration using custom device names, see the **How-To** section of [BatchCheckDeviceNames](~~69482~~).  

## QPS Limit  

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 30 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-batch-register-device-status --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --apply-id 1295006 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
